units.function: Pure classifier that combines run status, issue state, persisted activity counts and English output heuristics into liveness/actionability/next-action labels.
units.dependencyDirection: Server helper imports only shared status types; the 19k-line Heartbeat service builds its inputs from many DB tables and persists its result.
units.keyDataModels: RunLivenessState, actionability, continuation attempt, evidence counters, next action and last useful action timestamp.
units.lifecycle: Normalize evidence, strip transcript noise, regex-classify blockers/approval/manager review/runnable language, then label success as completed/blocked/advanced/plan-only/follow-up/empty.
units.testAssessment: Fourteen focused tests cover planning-only, empty output, evidence, planning exemptions, blockers, durable-comment precedence, approval language, production review and background-process loss. They are English-fixture tests only; no multilingual, adversarial phrasing, false-positive corpus, structured Connector signal or confidence calibration exists. Counting any non-bookkeeping activity/tool event as progress does not prove successful useful work.
units.designRationale: Detect Agents that narrate future work without acting and bound automatic continuation without another model call.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss needs honest liveness and bounded recovery across vendors, languages and deployment profiles.
units.companyOsFit: Use only as an optional low-confidence UX heuristic. Company OS canonical liveness must come from structured Connector progress/pause/evidence/result events, state transitions and deadlines; approval or risk routing can never depend on text regexes.
units.responsibilityConflict: Agent-controlled text can declare or hide approval/blocker language, while generic event counts can falsely imply progress. Neither is proof of permission, accountable-human approval or result evidence.

units.function: Unit corpus for Paperclip's regex/evidence-based liveness classifier.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest imports the pure classifier with literal run/issue/output fixtures.
units.keyDataModels: Run state, output text, evidence counts, actionability and next action.
units.lifecycle: Supply representative English output and compare one classification.
units.testAssessment: Good regression coverage for known cases, including preferring durable comments over dangerous transcript text. It lacks multilingual/adversarial/property tests and validates regex outcomes rather than an authoritative protocol.
units.designRationale: Keep automatic retries stable as textual Agent behavior evolves.
units.companyOsProblem: Fallback heuristics need a falsification corpus and must never silently become policy.
units.companyOsFit: Borrow adversarial transcript-precedence cases for a non-authoritative fallback suite; add explicit confidence/source labels and prove security decisions ignore this output.
units.responsibilityConflict: The test named 'keeps approval requests out' may suggest a security guarantee it cannot provide against rephrasing or non-English output.

units.function: Compatibility barrel re-exporting bounded liveness-continuation policy from the larger recovery module.
units.dependencyDirection: No logic is owned here; callers import through this path while implementation lives under services/recovery.
units.keyDataModels: Continuation decision, attempt limit, reason and idempotency key.
units.testAssessment: The corresponding unit test reaches the re-exported pure decision function, but this file itself has no contract/versioning test and the canonical recovery module remains a separate pending audit unit.
units.designRationale: Preserve an older import boundary while recovery code is reorganized.
units.companyOsProblem: Stable module entry points are useful during internal migration but should not obscure canonical ownership.
units.companyOsFit: Do not copy a compatibility barrel. Company OS should publish one explicit RecoveryPolicy application contract and deprecate aliases deliberately.
units.responsibilityConflict: None in the barrel; responsibility behavior resides in the still-pending recovery implementation.

units.function: Pure policy tests for bounded plan-only/empty-response continuation and guard conditions.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest imports the compatibility barrel; fixtures cast partial DB rows to never.
units.keyDataModels: Source run, issue assignment/execution state, Agent status, budget block, attempt and wake payload.
units.lifecycle: Evaluate first/second retry, exhaustion and guarded skip cases.
units.testAssessment: Covers two-attempt bound, idempotency key shape, reassignment, terminal issue, execution policy, paused Agent, budget and existing wake. It does not cover concurrency against the DB, responsible-human continuity, action/data contract, cancellation, timeout or malicious nextAction text.
units.designRationale: Prevent endless automatic loops after non-progressing runs.
units.companyOsProblem: Recovery must be bounded, idempotent and subordinate to responsibility/risk policy.
units.companyOsFit: Adapt the bounded-attempt and reassignment/budget guards after auditing the canonical recovery module; add exact contract digest and Connector capability assertions.
units.responsibilityConflict: The continuation payload carries instructions but no immutable work/responsibility/approval/data digest, so a resumed execution is not proven equivalent to the original authority.

units.function: Process-local, TTL-bound live status projection for a run's phase/message/tool/assistant snippet with heuristic secret redaction.
units.dependencyDirection: In-memory server adapter depends on Paperclip redaction and shared phase enum; UI readers query it through surrounding Heartbeat APIs.
units.keyDataModels: Company/issue/Agent/run scope, phase, sanitized message/tool/snippet and activity timestamps.
units.lifecycle: Set or touch a scoped Map entry, clone on read, reject scope mismatch and clear/sweep after 90 seconds.
units.testAssessment: Six tests cover scoping, redaction/truncation, expiry, touch monotonicity/fallback and sweep. No multi-process consistency, process restart, capacity/eviction, Unicode size, redaction bypass or authorization-call-site test exists.
units.designRationale: Give responsive live UI feedback without turning noisy transient status into durable database state.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss and office entities need transient working/waiting state while durable evidence remains separate.
units.companyOsFit: The ephemeral-versus-durable split, TTL and scope checks are useful. Company OS should expose an Office/Run Projection port with managed-cloud pub/sub or local memory adapter, bounded capacity and typed safe status codes rather than arbitrary Agent text.
units.responsibilityConflict: Sanitized snippets are not evidence and must not enter the responsibility chain; heuristic redaction is defense-in-depth only.

units.function: Extracts/truncates selected adapter result fields, merges a fallback summary and chooses text to post as an Issue comment.
units.dependencyDirection: Pure server helper accepts untyped vendor result JSON; Heartbeat persistence/comment paths call it.
units.keyDataModels: summary/result/message/error, three cost aliases and timeout/stop metadata.
units.lifecycle: Merge missing summary, project allowlisted top-level fields and select summary/result/message for a comment.
units.testAssessment: Eight tests cover truncation, alias preservation, irrelevant payloads, fallback order and merge precedence. The helper does not redact text, validate numeric cost types, attach currency/provider/model/token dimensions, preserve an evidence digest or bound the full issue-comment length; safe JSON byte constants are defined but not enforced inside this module.
units.designRationale: Keep live/list responses and issue comments useful without returning entire provider payloads.
units.companyOsProblem: Connector outputs need safe structured projection while raw evidence stays governed and immutable.
units.companyOsFit: Reference the projection-before-display idea only. Company OS requires a versioned Result envelope, typed usage/cost, sensitivity labels, evidence digest and separate localized presentation mapper.
units.responsibilityConflict: Free-form adapter summary posted as a durable work comment can be mistaken for verified result evidence and may contain sensitive content unless every caller redacts correctly.

units.function: Unit tests for result projection, comment fallback and summary merge precedence.
units.dependencyDirection: Pure Vitest fixtures call summary helpers.
units.keyDataModels: Untyped result JSON and projected summary/comment.
units.lifecycle: Pass representative payloads and compare exact output.
units.testAssessment: Useful allowlist regression tests, but they do not include secrets/PII, malformed costs, huge Unicode output, evidence links or untrusted Markdown/prompt content.
units.designRationale: Prevent provider-result shape changes from polluting list/comment surfaces.
units.companyOsProblem: Presentation projections need explicit safety and provenance tests.
units.companyOsFit: Adapt the allowlist/fallback cases into typed ResultProjection tests and add redaction, data policy and evidence-digest assertions.
units.responsibilityConflict: The tests equate chosen text with a valid Issue comment without proving who produced or verified it.

units.function: Infers normalized run stop reason and timeout metadata from adapter type/config, outcome, error code and English error message.
units.dependencyDirection: Pure helper embeds Paperclip adapter names/config keys and is called from Heartbeat finalization.
units.keyDataModels: Outcome, stop reason, effective timeout, configured/source/fired flags.
units.lifecycle: Read timeoutMs/timeoutSec with adapter-specific defaults, infer reason, then merge metadata into result JSON.
units.testAssessment: Seven tests cover local defaults, configured timeout, budget/manual cancellation, graceful interruption, max-turn normalization, inconsistent success and merge. Critical gaps: local coding adapters default to unlimited timeout; budget/paused cancellation is inferred from English message substrings; invalid/negative config silently becomes zero; no Connector-declared reason/version is required.
units.designRationale: Normalize heterogeneous adapters enough for UI/diagnostics without changing every adapter result.
units.companyOsProblem: Connector-neutral execution needs authoritative, stable terminal reasons and bounded timeout policy.
units.companyOsFit: Do not reuse. Company OS Connector SDK must emit typed terminal reason/error code and negotiated timeout/cancellation semantics; deployment/risk policy supplies bounded defaults and invalid values fail closed.
units.responsibilityConflict: Misclassifying a manual cancellation as budget pause changes organizational meaning, and an unlimited default can leave delegated authority running indefinitely.

units.function: Best-effort annotation of an active Heartbeat run with one of two responsible-user authorization denial codes plus live-status publication.
units.dependencyDirection: HTTP error middleware fire-and-forgets this DB/live-event helper after an Agent request is denied.
units.keyDataModels: Run/Agent/company scope and RESPONSIBLE_USER_UNAUTHORIZED or RESPONSIBLE_USER_UNAVAILABLE error code.
units.lifecycle: Validate code, conditionally update queued/running run errorCode, publish live event and log; middleware swallows recording failure.
units.testAssessment: Three mocked tests cover code filtering, scoped update fields and live-event payload. They do not verify real SQL conditions, races, cancellation/pause, durable audit, repeated denials, terminalization or propagation to Connector control.
units.designRationale: Make on-behalf-of denials visible on the live run instead of only returning an HTTP error to the Agent.
units.companyOsProblem: Loss of accountable-human authority must immediately suspend affected work and create a durable responsibility/security event.
units.companyOsFit: Do not copy best-effort annotation as enforcement. Company OS must fail closed in the application use case, atomically append denial/audit, transition work to paused/blocked and issue Connector pause/cancel with retryable delivery receipt.
units.responsibilityConflict: The run stays queued/running and only its errorCode changes; recording is fire-and-forget. This is observability, not enforcement of human responsibility.

units.function: Best-effort helper that wakes an assigned non-backlog Agent with issue/task references after assignment-related mutations.
units.dependencyDirection: Issue routes inject the large Heartbeat service; helper knows its source/reason/context vocabulary.
units.keyDataModels: Issue ID/assignee/status, mutation/reason, task key and requester attribution.
units.lifecycle: Skip unassigned/backlog, enqueue assignment wake, swallow/log failure unless explicitly configured to rethrow.
units.testAssessment: No focused test belongs to this unit. Call sites mostly mock it, leaving exact idempotency, responsibility resolution, status races and failure policy unproven.
units.designRationale: Centralize repeated issue-assignment wake payload construction and avoid making ordinary mutations fail on transient scheduler errors.
units.companyOsProblem: Work assignment must reliably dispatch once and preserve initiator/responsible-human/action-contract context.
units.companyOsFit: Do not reuse the fire-and-forget helper. Company OS should persist a transactional dispatch outbox with idempotency/action digest and let a delivery worker call AgentExecutionPort.
units.responsibilityConflict: Wake payload contains attribution but no responsibility contract or exact permission/data grant; swallowed failure can leave assigned work silently undispatched.

units.function: Builds dependency-resolution wake idempotency keys and queries for existing wake requests in selected states.
units.dependencyDirection: Thin DB helper depends directly on the Heartbeat wakeup table; actual dependency transition and enqueue behavior lives in Issue routes/services.
units.keyDataModels: Dependent/blocker IDs, company-scoped idempotency key and wake status.
units.lifecycle: Derive deterministic key, query one existing non-skipped wake for one or several legacy/current keys.
units.testAssessment: No focused unit test exists; route integration covers three dependency/child-terminal scenarios. The schema has no general unique constraint for this idempotency-key family, so check-then-insert can race; 'claimed' is omitted from one related liveness idempotency set and status sets vary across helpers.
units.designRationale: Avoid duplicate Agent wakes when several blocker/parent transitions converge.
units.companyOsProblem: Event-driven work dependencies require atomic deduplication and replay-safe dispatch.
units.companyOsFit: Deterministic causal keys are useful, but Company OS must enforce uniqueness at the dispatch store and compare command digest, not rely on preflight reads with scattered status lists.
units.responsibilityConflict: Deduplicating by issue IDs does not prove the wake uses the same responsible human, work revision or execution authorization.
